mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low interest rates (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise above 1.5 million units, it signals increased demand for housing, leading to higher economic activity, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high housing starts (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and CPI are both rising, it signals an inflationary environment, leading to decreased purchasing power, which drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment and the unemployment rate are both rising, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low-unemployment periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales and housing starts are both rising, it signals increased demand for goods and services, leading to higher economic activity, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where retail sales growth exceeds 5% YoY and housing starts exceed 1.5 million units.
